name: Passive House (PHI)
summary: Passivhaus Institut standard. Heating demand <= 15 kWh/m²/yr; airtightness <= 0.6 ACH50; primary energy <= 60 kWh/m²/yr.

name: ADA Standards 1991
summary: Original ADA Accessibility Guidelines. Superseded by the 2010 Standards.

name: UN-Habitat Five Principles
summary: Adequate street space (>=30% of land), high density (>=15,000/km²), mixed land use (>=40% non-residential), social mix, limited specialisation.
sources: UN-Habitat: A New Strategy for Sustainable Neighborhood Planning, 2014

name: NACTO Urban Street Design Guide
summary: National Association of City Transportation Officials. Defines complete streets typologies, intersection design, and traffic-calming toolkit.

name: ITDP TOD Standard v3.0
summary: Institute for Transportation and Development Policy. 21 indicators across 8 principles (Walk, Cycle, Connect, Transit, Mix, Densify, Compact, Shift).

name: ITDP BRT Standard
summary: ITDP scorecard for BRT corridor design. Bronze / Silver / Gold tiers across 31 indicators.

name: LEED ND v4.1
summary: 110-point credit system across Smart Location & Linkage, Neighborhood Pattern & Design, Green Infrastructure & Buildings.
sources: LEED v4.1 ND Reference Guide, USGBC

name: BREEAM Communities
summary: BRE Global. Five categories: Governance, Social and Economic Wellbeing, Resources and Energy, Land Use and Ecology, Transport and Movement.

name: WELL Community Standard
summary: IWBI. Eleven concepts: Air, Water, Nourishment, Light, Movement, Thermal Comfort, Sound, Materials, Mind, Community, Innovation.

name: Living Building Challenge 4.0
summary: International Living Future Institute. Seven Petals: Place, Water, Energy, Health & Happiness, Materials, Equity, Beauty. Net-positive across all.

name: International Building Code 2021
summary: ICC. Defines occupancy classification, construction types, means of egress, fire safety, structural, accessibility requirements.

name: NFPA 101 Life Safety Code 2021
summary: NFPA. Egress, fire safety, occupant features. Often referenced alongside IBC.

name: ADA Standards 2010
summary: 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design. Mandatory for federal facilities; widely referenced in commercial design. Replaced 1991 ADAAG.

name: ASHRAE 90.1-2019
summary: Energy Standard for Buildings Except Low-Rise Residential. Envelope, HVAC, lighting, power requirements.

name: ASHRAE 62.1-2022
summary: Ventilation for Acceptable Indoor Air Quality. Defines minimum outdoor air rates by occupancy.

name: ASHRAE 55-2020
summary: Thermal Environmental Conditions for Human Occupancy. PMV/PPD model and adaptive model for naturally ventilated buildings.

name: Eurocode EN 1990
summary: Basis of structural design for all materials. Limit states, partial factors, combinations of actions.

name: ISO 19650
summary: Organisation and digitisation of information about buildings using BIM. International successor to PAS 1192.

name: IFC 4 (ISO 16739:2013)
summary: buildingSMART Industry Foundation Classes 4. Open neutral data schema for BIM interoperability.

name: IFC 4.3 ADD2
summary: Extends IFC into infrastructure: rail, road, ports & waterways, bridges, alignment. ISO 16739-1:2024.
